title: Layered circuit size class
statement: A language $L$ belongs to layered size $T$ if there is a family $C$ of layered Boolean circuits such that every circuit uses only the standard gate operations, the circuit on $n$ input bits has size at most $T(n)$ for every natural number $n$, and the language recognized by $C$ is exactly $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers
$L$ is a language of Boolean words
